scraper_battery.help: 1 if battery support is enabled (always exported).

scraper_up.help: 1 if the last Modbus poll of the inverter succeeded.

scraper_modbus_errors_total.help: Total failed or rejected polls since start.

scraper_last_poll_timestamp_seconds.help: Unix time of the last successful poll.

scraper_poll_duration_seconds.help: Duration of the last poll cycle (the reads + the sanity checks) in seconds.

scraper_poll_duration_mean_seconds.help: Mean poll cycle duration so far in seconds.

scraper_poll_duration_max_seconds.help: Longest poll cycle duration so far in seconds — a slow dongle shows here before the freshness gap does.

scraper_cache_device_up.help: 1 when the modbus-cache in front of the device finished its last poll cycle with at least one successful read, 0 when the device is unreachable behind the cache.

scraper_cache_age_seconds.help: Seconds since the modbus-cache's last successful device read (65535 = none yet). Grows while the device is down behind the cache.

scraper_cache_uptime_seconds.help: Uptime of the modbus-cache process in seconds.
